Generated responses to instruction prompts with verifiable constraints

changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to standard capitalization. Removed redundant dataset entries and simplified outputs description. The paper focuses on instruction following as the NLG task.
Consolidated all constraint satisfaction metrics under a single normalized name since they represent the same evaluation approach with different scoring methods.

Changed answer from Yes to No. The LLM self-evaluation is used DURING tree search for guiding generation (MCTS), not AFTER generation for judging outputs. This is part of the generation process, not evaluation.
No human evaluations were conducted in this paper. The paper explicitly states they use automated verification of constraint satisfaction.

overall_notes: The paper systematically studies preference learning for instruction-following LLMs using synthetic data with verifiable constraints. It uses automated constraint satisfaction metrics but does not use LLMs as judges for evaluation - the LLM self-evaluation mentioned is part of the MCTS generation process, not post-generation assessment.
